author: Aletheia I
title: Local Attention Transformer for RNA Modeling
abstract: This submission introduces a fundamentally new architecture to break the performance plateau of 1D CNNs. It implements a Transformer-based model that relies entirely on self-attention. To overcome the O(L^2) complexity of standard attention on long sequences, this model uses a custom local attention mask, restricting each position to attend to a fixed-size window of its neighbors. The model incorporates learned positional embeddings to retain sequence order. The final sequence representation is aggregated using the proven dual max/average pooling strategy. This approach is hypothesized to be more flexible than CNNs while remaining computationally tractable.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

# --- Hyperparameters ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001, 'hidden_dim': 512, 'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'd_model': 256, 'num_heads': 4, 'num_layers': 4,
        'attention_window': 32, 'max_len': 1200 # A safe max length for positional embeddings
    }

# --- Transformer Block ---
class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int; num_heads: int; dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, mask=None, deterministic=True):
        # Self-Attention
        attn_output = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.num_heads)(
            inputs_q=x, mask=mask, deterministic=deterministic
        )
        x = nn.LayerNorm()(x + nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(attn_output, deterministic=deterministic))
        
        # Feed-Forward Network
        ffn_output = nn.Dense(features=self.d_model*2)(x)
        ffn_output = nn.relu(ffn_output)
        ffn_output = nn.Dense(features=self.d_model)(ffn_output)
        x = nn.LayerNorm()(x + nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(ffn_output, deterministic=deterministic))
        return x

# --- Main Transformer Model ---
class LocalTransformer(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        seq_len = x.shape[1]
        
        # 1. Input Embedding
        x = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_model'])(x)
        pos_embed = self.param('pos_embedding', nn.initializers.zeros, (self.hparams['max_len'], self.hparams['d_model']))
        x = x + pos_embed[:seq_len, :]
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 2. Create Local Attention Mask
        idx = jnp.arange(seq_len)
        mask = jnp.abs(idx[:, None] - idx[None, :]) > self.hparams['attention_window']
        # Mask shape is (seq_len, seq_len), it will be broadcasted to (batch, heads, seq_len, seq_len)
        
        # 3. Transformer Body
        for _ in range(self.hparams['num_layers']):
            x = TransformerBlock(d_model=self.hparams['d_model'], num_heads=self.hparams['num_heads'], 
                                 dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(x, mask=mask, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 4. Aggregation and Prediction
        x_max = jnp.max(x, axis=1)
        x_avg = jnp.mean(x, axis=1)
        x = jnp.concatenate([x_max, x_avg], axis=-1)
        
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['hidden_dim'])(x)
        y = nn.relu(y); y = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(y, deterministic=deterministic)
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_output'])(y)
        
        if self.hparams['task_type'] == "regression": return y.squeeze(-1)
        else: return y

# --- Network Wrapper ---
class TransformerWrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams): self.network = LocalTransformer(hparams=hparams)
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        return self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)['params']
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        rngs = {}; rngs['dropout'] = rng_key if rng_key is not None else random.PRNGKey(0)
        return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs=rngs)

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]): return TransformerWrapper(hparams)
